decisions.question: D12-Q02
decisions.rule: Monthly service targets, measured by the independent monitor with planned upgrades excluded. Chain: a block committed in at least 99.9% of minutes (about 43 minutes of halt budget a month). Endpoints: at least one client endpoint serving state within 3 blocks of the head in at least 99.5% of minutes (about 3.6 hours a month).

decisions.question: D12-Q02
decisions.rule: Severity 1 (chain halted, a validator at double-sign risk, a key compromise, monitoring down) pages 24/7: acknowledged within 15 minutes, a responder at a console within 30 minutes. Severity 2 within 4 hours; severity 3 the next business day. At least two people in the rotation plus an escalation contact.

decisions.question: D12-Q02
decisions.rule: Full chain history on at least two archive nodes run by different operators on different providers, plus a monthly offline export; other nodes keep the approved retained window. Logs 90 days, redacted (no secrets or personal data). Metrics 13 months. Incident, alert and audit records kept permanently.

decisions.question: D12-Q02
decisions.rule: RPO zero committed blocks: a restore never rolls back history. The approved daily snapshots are copied, encrypted with AES-256, to a second provider. Keys move only through custody, never in routine backups. A validator's signing state is never restored from a backup, and a replacement signs only after the old host is fenced off. RTO: validator 8 hours (2 hours to provision plus the approved 6-hour catch-up), sentry 4 hours, endpoint service 15 minutes by failover, monitoring 1 hour. Restore drills quarterly on staging.

unset: Named on-call people, contacts and the escalation contact (D14-Q03)
Archive node operators and providers, backup providers (D12-Q03)
